To whom it may concern

New and old Methuselah get ready to rise up from your long slumber. it is now in due time to reclaim the Northern Territories of Europe (aka Norway) who will be the controlling faction at the end? will it be the sects of the Camarilla, Sabatt, Anarch or maybe something far greater and more powerful?

It is with great honor as the newly appointed NC of Norway to invite you all to participate in the:

*** Norwegian National Championship of 2022 ***

Date: 6th August 2022
Registration: 09:00 CET
First round: 10:00

Type of Event: National Championship ( Tournament Rules )

With this being a National Championship, Proxy cards are not allowed.

Number of rounds: 3 (2h time limit) + final (2h and 30m)
Time limit will be 2 Hours (the finals will have an additional 30 minutes time (2h and 30m))

The address for the venue is:
